name: Hubei Three Gorges Tourism Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Three Gorges Tourism Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of road passenger transport services in China. The company offers passenger travel services comprising road passenger transport, bus station services, taxi passenger transport, vehicle extension services, trade and logistics services, tourism transportation services, sightseeing cruise services, travel agency business, tourism port services, and tourism scenic area operation; and commercial and logistics services, including property leasing, steel logistics, and supermarket sales.
